defects.claim: A closed record cache still reports writable and its explicit flush can send a queued failed write after close
defects.scenario: close returns false with a failed write still queued; a later explicit flush sends it, and the cache keeps reporting writable
defects.cause: writable predicate omits closed; flush delegates straight to queue

defects.claim: cloneEqual overflows the stack on cyclic records, so remote reconciliation rejects without applying or retrying
defects.scenario: two separately cloned cyclic records compared during remote reconciliation overflow the stack; the comparison runs after the read catch, so reconciliation rejects

defects.claim: IndexedDB peer notification broadcasts the caller's object after commit, not the committed snapshot, and set can reject after the write landed
defects.scenario: caller mutates the object between put and commit; peers receive the mutated value while a read returns the committed snapshot; a mutation that makes it unclonable makes set reject after the write
defects.cause: broadcasts the caller's object rather than the snapshot cloned at put time
